usage: claw-eval [-h]
                 {run,_run-inner,build-image,grade,batch,cleanup,list} ...

Claw evaluation framework

positional arguments:
  {run,_run-inner,build-image,grade,batch,cleanup,list}
    run                 Run agent on a task
    _run-inner          ==SUPPRESS==
    build-image         Build the sandbox Docker image
    grade               Grade an existing trace
    batch               Run all tasks in parallel
    cleanup             Remove all claw-eval Docker containers
    list                List available tasks

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

Usage: vision2web [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Vision2Web: Benchmark for visual web development with AI agents

Options:
  --version  Show the version and exit.
  --help     Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  analyze    Analyze evaluation results and print summary statistics
  evaluate   Run evaluation phase to test generated projects
  inference  Run inference phase to generate projects from specifications

👋 INFO     This is SWE-agent version 1.1.0 (hash='unavailable') with SWE-ReX   
            version 1.4.0 (rex_hash='unavailable').                             
Main command line interface for SWE-agent.

=== USAGE ===

sweagent <command> 

Display usage instructions for a specific command:

sweagent <command> --help

=== SUBCOMMANDS TO RUN SWE-AGENT ===

run or r: Run swe-agent on a single problem statement, for example a github 
issue.
run-batch or b: Run swe-agent on a batch of problem statements, e.g., on 
SWE-Bench.

=== MISC SUBCOMMANDS ===

merge-preds: Merge multiple prediction files into a single file. In most cases
    run-batch will already do this, but you can use this to merge predictions
    from multiple directories.
inspect or i: Open a single trajectory file in a terminal-based viewer.
inspector or I: Open trajectories in a web-based viewer.
run-replay: Replay a trajectory file or a demo file.
    This can be useful to fill in environment output when creating 
demonstrations.
traj-to-demo: Convert a trajectory file to an easy to edit demo file.
run-api: Run swe-agent as a backend for a GUI
remove-unfinished or ru: Remove unfinished trajectories
quick-stats or qs: Calculate quick stats from a directory of trajectories
